name: seat-router
description: Routes marked Agent calls through durable external seats

heavySeats.title: Heavy tasks: models (leave as auto)
heavySeats.description: Leave as auto: the mod uses the models your codex and agy report. To choose, run /seats setup after installing.

standardSeats.title: Standard tasks: models (leave as auto)
standardSeats.description: Leave as auto: the mod uses the models your codex and agy report. To choose, run /seats setup after installing.

lightSeats.title: Light tasks: models (leave as auto)
lightSeats.description: Leave as auto: the mod uses the models your codex and agy report. To choose, run /seats setup after installing.

busyAt.title: Busy at % used (leave at 80)
busyAt.description: A model counts as busy, and is tried after free ones, once any of its quota windows is this used, until that window resets; a week used over 15 points ahead of the time passed counts too.

mixFanouts.title: Mix model families when several agents share a task (leave on)
mixFanouts.description: Asks the session to add a seat per other model family beside the Claude agents whenever it runs several agents on the same task, unless you or a skill in use says otherwise.

delegate.title: Delegate code work: auto, on or off (leave as auto)
delegate.description: Sends features, fixes and PR owners to owner seats on your other CLIs: auto while Claude's quota is busy or out, on always, off never. /seats setup asks it too.

claudeAccounts.title: Other Claude accounts (leave empty)
claudeAccounts.description: Claude subscriptions on this machine besides the session's own, as comma-separated <name> <config folder>, e.g. work ~/.claude-work. A seat line naming one (seat: work standard reviewer) runs Claude on that account.

jobs.title: Jobs: where each kind of work runs (leave empty)
jobs.description: A seat line's optional last word names a job. Shipped: code, and image (only models that make images). Add or change jobs as <job> [(<what it is for>)]: <rule>, ... separated by ;, a rule being only, not or first and a CLI, family, account or model pattern, e.g. art (layouts, styling, images, diagrams): only codex, only agy, not claude, first codex. /seats setup asks it too.

minFreeDiskGiB.title: Minimum free disk space (GiB)
minFreeDiskGiB.description: Refuse a new worktree seat below this free space on the seat home volume. Running seats continue. Default 10 leaves room for several typical build worktrees.
